svg.title: Accumulator charge control with hysteresis 10.8 / 11.5 MPa, start 10.7, alarm 10.0 (example)
svg.text: Accumulator charging with hysteresis – what Networks 3 and 4 do (4 L accumulator, pump 5.39 L/min, decided band of guide 09 §27)
Cut-in 10.8 MPa, cut-out 11.5 MPa, start interlock ≥ 10.7 MPa, alarm < 10.0 MPa (0.5 s). Pressure slope ≈ 4.5 MPa per litre in this band.
• Pauses: leakage (0.15 L/min → − 0.011 MPa/s) + B-table clamps (0.037 L = − 0.17 MPa each). The pump idles to tank until 10.8 MPa (cut-in).
• Change: the request is SET at the start of S2 (unclamp) and of S6 (clamp, after the lower) and RESET at 11.5 MPa (cut-out).
Pump 5.39 L/min = 0.090 L/s → + 0.40 MPa/s. Lift alone: − 0.118 L × 4.5 = − 0.53 MPa in 0.8 s (+ 0.32 MPa refill) → net ≈ − 0.2 MPa.
• Without pump help: 11.5 → 10.75 MPa after release + lift (guide 09 §24.2); starting at 10.7 → 10.03 MPa ≥ 10.0 = still OK; that is why start ≥ 10.7.
• SET at 10.8 / RESET at 11.5 in Network 3 = the hysteresis. With one threshold only, the valve would chatter (on / off every scan).
Guide 36 – PLC ladder program of the APC
